title: Hold a food business licence
what: Notify, register or license the food business with the enforcement agency (usually the local council) before trading, and meet the Food Standards Code.

sources.title: Food Act 2006 (Qld)
sources.quote: A person must not carry on a licensable food business unless the person holds a licence to carry on the business.
